data.question: How should an SEO team audit query fanout?
data.summary: A synthetic result used only to test the local handoff parser and page-decision workflow.

branches.rationale: The page decision needs a stable outcome before coverage is reviewed.
branches.assumption: The team can name one primary job.

branches.rationale: Existing pages must be checked before another URL is proposed.
Each material claim needs an appropriate and maintainable source role.
The workflow should end in an edit, merge, evidence task, URL, or no action.
branches.assumption: The inventory is complete enough to decide.

data.notice: Owner-authored synthetic fixture. Not an AI Fanout export, provider result, demand signal, or benchmark.
